rows.grounds: compound of ḍākinī, graha, and bhūta in neuter plural form
neuter noun in nominative or accusative singular

items.question: How do ḍākinī seizure spirits vanish when sunrise dispels darkness?
premises: ḍākinī seizure spirits likened to darkness
items.inference: therefore sunrise removes ḍākinī seizure spirits
items.plain_english: As darkness disappears at sunrise, so do ḍākinī seizure spirits.
